metaDescription: Shop custom padded school spirit gear for comfort and style. Perfect for fans and teams. Order bulk from Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Padded school spirit gear adds extra comfort and warmth for fans at games, pep rallies, and outdoor events. Choose from padded vests, jackets, and hoodies that keep your logo visible while providing insulation. Perfect for cold-weather spirit wear, these items are popular for student sections, booster clubs, and alumni groups. Decorate with screen printing or embroidery to match your school colors.
